name: Four Seasson Apartment 2
description:

About this propertySpacious and Modern: Four Seasson Apartment 2 in Baku offers a spacious, recently renovated apartment with four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Guests enjoy sea views, air-conditioning, and a terrace.

Comfortable Living: The apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, balcony, and a living room with a sofa bed. Additional amenities include a washing machine, work desk, and free WiFi.

Delicious Breakfast: A variety of breakfast options are available, including continental, American, Italian, full English/Irish, vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free, kosher, and Asian. Fresh pastries, pancakes, and local specialities are served.

Prime Location: Located on Nizami Street, the apartment is an 8-minute walk from Maiden Tower and less than 1 km from Palace of The Shirvanshahs. Heydar Aliyev International Airport is 25 km away. An ice-skating rink is nearby.Solo travellers particularly like the location — they rated it 10 for a one-person stay.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
